description: OQ5 suite-ignition curated seed set (blueprint §33 cold-start fix, §17 P1 decision). Each case is a RegressionCase-shaped object tagged with origin in {curated, genuine, synthetic}. Per the OQ5 decision the active suite size N_active counts ONLY curated+genuine cases (synthetic NEVER counts and is capped at 2x curated). The shadow->active flip fires at N_active=30: >=20 curated trusted held-out cases, >=5 genuine-style cases, all protected tiers present. This dataset is exactly what PromotionGate.ignition_status (gate.py, to be wired by Codex) consumes to decide SHADOW vs ACTIVE. Internal-only per §9/§12 N3 - never reported as a public benchmark.

origin_semantics.curated: Hand-authored, trusted, held-out regression case. Counts toward N_active.
origin_semantics.genuine: Genuine-style case modelled on real captured-episode phrasing/usage. Counts toward N_active.
origin_semantics.synthetic: Auto-generated / adversarial probe. NEVER counts toward N_active; capped at 2x curated count.
